description: This Swift source file defines the CanvasWindowController class, which manages a macOS window containing a WKWebView for rendering and interacting with web-based canvas content within the OpenClaw project. It handles web view configuration, loading URLs or files, executing JavaScript, taking snapshots, and managing communication between the native app and web content.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A macOS window controller that embeds a WKWebView for rendering web-based canvas content, handling URL loading, JavaScript evaluation, snapshots, and communication with web content.

methods.name: showCanvas
methods.description: Displays the web view with optional loading of a specific path or URL.

methods.name: hideCanvas
methods.description: Hides the window displaying the web view.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a given target URL or file path into the web view, handling different schemes.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status display with optional title and subtitle.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Applies the current debug status settings to the web view via JavaScript.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript string within the web view and returns the result asynchronously.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the web view content and saves it as a PNG file, returning the file path.

methods.name: directoryPath
methods.description: Returns the session directory path associated with this controller.
